arStrings.szText: To bring clarity to her strange visions, a bold Seer aims to restore the Sightless Eye.

Ghosts of the past stir at the Sepulture of Scales. Do they fear us? Do they hate us? Or are they merely stirred into a frenzy by the lingering power of the Sightless Eye? Despite the dangers, Athrpa is undeterred. I must help her find the answers she seeks.

The Sepulture of Scales was an ancient proving ground for young Seers. The spirits of those who did not pass the trial still haunt this place. We have braved ghosts and trials alike, and the answers we seek lie just ahead, within the Hall of Account.

The Hall of Account holds something precious: the First Oracle's writings. This text speaks of invoking the name of the angel Lycander in the presence of the Sightless Eye. If this is the only way to restore the artifact, so be it. I must help Athrpa with the ritual.
